```{r, echo = FALSE, message=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(message = FALSE, warning=FALSE)
# plotly.js from the CDN, so the site's pages don't each copy it
options(plotly.core.plotlyjs = "cdn")
```
### Map Tiles, no Token Needed

plotly.core draws density heatmaps on MapLibre tile maps with `add_densitymap()`
and `update_layout(map = go_map(...))`. The built-in styles (such as
`"open-street-map"`, `"carto-positron"` or `"carto-darkmatter"`) need no access
token. See [Map Layers](mapbox-layers.html) for more information.

#### Open Street Map Tiles

```{r}
library(plotly.core)

quakes <- read.csv("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/plotly/datasets/master/earthquakes-23k.csv")

quakes |>
  go_figure() |>
  add_densitymap(
    lat = ~Latitude,
    lon = ~Longitude,
    coloraxis = "coloraxis",
    radius = 10
  ) |>
  update_layout(
    map = go_map(style = "open-street-map", center = go_map_center(lon = 180)),
    coloraxis = go_coloraxis(colorscale = "Viridis")
  )
```

#Reference

See `go_densitymap()` for more information and options!
